title: Hearty Velvety Italian Egg Frittata
description: A pungent and velvety Italian dish featuring eggs, perfect for a post-workout meal, this frittata is a nut-free friendly option that combines the richness of eggs with the savory flavor of Italian seasonings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, and dried basil until well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Pour the whisked egg mixture over the cherry tomatoes in the skillet.
Sprinkle the grated parmesan cheese evenly over the top of the egg mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top of the frittata.
Let the frittata cool in the skillet for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
